profile.headline: Driving Scalable Solutions | Full Stack Engineer | Enterprise Architecture | AI & Microservices Evangelist
profile.summary:
Extensive Software Development experience of design and development Software applications for domains like Healthcare, Entertainment, Mobile Applications.

Specialties: 
- Web Development using frameworks like AngularJS, Flux, ECMAScript 6, HTML5, Typescript, Angular 4, Redux, Ngrx
- Functional Programming using Scala
- Strong knowledge of healthcare domain, DICOM, HL7
- Hands-on experience of Big Data tools like Apache Spark, Hive, Spark SQL, Scala, Java
- Expert in C++, MFC/ATL, SQL, Object-Oriented and Functional Programming
- Ability to work with cross-functional team

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Full Stack
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Architected and built cloud-native systems using Golang and Angular, enabling resilient, high-performance applications for edge orchestration.
- Drove Kubernetes-based deployment strategies that improved operational efficiency and service reliability across multi-region edge environments.
- Defined the technical roadmap in close collaboration with product leaders and platform architects, aligning system design with long-term business objectives.
- Mentored and guided engineering teams through best practices in full-stack development, API design, infrastructure automation, and code quality.
- Enhanced system reliability through distributed tracing, observability improvements, and proactive incident response processes.
- Established modern DevOps practices, including containerized workflows and CI/CD pipelines, accelerating release cycles and boosting deployment confidence.
- Fostered a culture of innovation and excellence, driving cross-functional collaboration across globally distributed teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Angular 2 · PostgreSQL · VMware vCenter · VMWare ESXi · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · DevOps · API Development · UI · JavaScript · TypeScript · GitHub · Software Design · Code Review · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Staff Engineer - Private Mobile Network
positions.description:
Private Mobile Network Orchestration project is designed to provide single-pane of glass kind of orchestration layer as Managed Service for various 4G/5G network configuration which involves complex components such as Radio Access Network deployment (RAN), Core deployment and their configuration etc.

- Lead full-stack engineer involved from conceptualization to Intial Availability of the product,
- Design and Development of PMNO as MicroService and MicroFrontEnd that would be integrated in Velocloud Orchestrator Product UI and Backend
- Taking the product development and release through various VMware Release Processes such as SDLC, Security Reviews, Accessbility Reviews etc.

positions.title: Staff Engineer - SD-WAN
positions.description:
- Worked as lead Full-Stack developer for VMware SD-WAN (formerly Velocloud) UI using Angular, Typescript, backend services using NodeJS, MySQL, Redis etc. 
- Participated in Design/Development of MicroFrontEnd and integrating in MicroService Architecture
- Lead effort of setting Angular Migration strategy for Edge Network Intelligence (ENI) UI to transition from AngularJS-based UI framework to Angular 10 based UI framework,  leverage VMware Clarity Design Library and pave path to integrate in MicroFrontEnd Strategy
- Worked on Critical UI modules such as c onfiguring Business Policies, GRE Tunnels, VLAN, SSO and Two-Factor Authentication etc.

positions.title: Senior MTS - NSX
positions.description:
Working in Networking & Security BU as Lead UI Engineer for NSX-T Manager, NSX Cloud and NSX Intelligence to architect, design and develop innovative, scalable and performant front-end using cutting-edge technologies which can provide pluggable module architecture, maintainable and reusable code-base and faster product development. 

The responsiblity of cross-functional team communication, closely working with UX and Product Managers to find out technically feasible and custom-oriented solution, and designing/developing scalable and performant solution is what excites and motivates me in my current role.

positions.title: Prinicipal Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Philips I works as UI Lead Developer to architect, design and develop cutting-edge Front-end for cloud-based Radiology Analytics Solution.

Responsibilities:

- Integrated latest web technology stack and programming practices into this solution such as AngularJS, HTML5, Gulp, ECMAScript6,  Babel.js, Bootstrap, Angular Material, Flux etc.
- Architect the solution to carved out separate components like Platform-SDK, Common Libraries and UI Layers as angular modules to increase code-reusability, testability and separation-of-concerns.
- Integrated build mechanism using Gulp, Browserify, BabelJS
- Communicate with UX Designer to integrate Philips Design Philosophies in front-end.
- Closely working with Product Owne and Marketing to understand, prototype, evaluate and develop requirements.
- Implemented Functional Testing Framework using Scala, ScalaTest, Selenium
- Contribute into design and development of server-side components like Admin Services, User Preference Management using Scala and Spray
- Other duties like, Unit Testing, Code Reviews, Preparing Design Documents etc.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
At SmithMicro, I got an opportunity to develop Media Manager client for Verizon Wireless that connect any Verizon device (like Nokia Symbian, Blackberry, Android). 
- Design & development of device integration module
- Design, development and integration of cloud-based media storage (called as Vault) in application.
- Integration of codecs like MP3, MP4, H264, Android's OGG, Theora and Vorbis
- Worked on VC++, MFC, .NET, Android, Audio/Video Codecs (MP3, OGG, MP4, H.264 etc.)

positions.title: SDET - Consultant
positions.description: At Microsoft, I had worked on exciting project of developing testing framework for XBOX 360. I had opportunity to design, develop and deliver the custom protocol to execute automated testcases from PC to targeted XBOX machines using techinologies like C++/C#, Xbox 360, XBOX SDK, WTT, UI Automation, MS Test

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on development of FTP Server development that allows easier integration with business process using rule-based configurations to store, deliver, notify about file transfers.
- Worked on VC++, MFC, Socket Programming, HTTP/FTP Server and Client development, SSL, HTML, JavaScript
